Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Ori Loro: 35-year-old woman, 168 cm (medium), unmistakably soft rounded construction with a clearly evident, naturally wider middle, short-to-average limbs, no cinched or flat waist, and gentle limb contours, skin value band-2-light. Face: round full face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: red-copper-auburn, long-loose, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette terracotta-black. Visible personal details: an extensive but nonmagical geometric tattoo language across both arms. Make repair, patina, customization, or a keepsake the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a polished seed case only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
